title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.13.0: Multiplayer expansion — The Understudy now has 5 co-op cards (base-game parity). New Duet (grant an ally Vigor equal to yours), Trading Fours (the old Duet), Antagonist (take all swappable/invertible debuffs from all allies), Ensemble (gain Vigor when an ally plays a card), and Conductor (allies echo your Vigor gains).
